name: UV Contraction for Z-fighting Prevention
definition: A preprocessing technique that scales UV coordinates of mesh vertices towards the center of their texture space to prevent sampling errors (seams, sparkly dots) at texture boundaries, specifically in voxel rendering or when using texture atlases.
summary: UV Contraction scales UV coordinates inward to prevent z-fighting in voxel rendering, differing from margin adjustment by actively shrinking the UV footprint within the atlas.
